screens.title: Choose the GitHub repository
screens.description: Shown only when remotes resolve to different numeric repository IDs (AmbiguousError).
screens.note: Remotes sharing an ID are one row with aliases. URLs are shown sanitized, never with credentials.

screens.title: Connect an existing Project
screens.description: ConnectExisting: explicit Project choice; same-name Projects are flagged, never auto-adopted.
screens.note: Fields are reused by name; only missing fields are added. Unrelated fields stay untouched.

screens.title: Preview the setup plan
screens.description: Pure plan preview: every label, Project and field step, reuse and manual step; import count is zero.
screens.note: Each row is a selectable step. Enter moves to confirmation; nothing is written here.

screens.title: Confirm the setup
screens.description: Exact consequence before Apply, in the C-01 confirmation style; Cancel has initial focus.
screens.note: Only Apply setup writes to GitHub. Escape cancels without writing.

screens.title: Setup is incomplete
screens.description: partial-setup: completed steps kept, failed step shows a safe code, Resume re-observes first.
screens.note: The user grants the scope; Bonsai never refreshes a token. Resume is the primary action.

screens.title: Read-only connection
screens.description: Read access: the Garden is readable, setup actions are absent with a reason.
screens.note: No setup or approval action is offered. Board, Table and Drafts remain readable.

screens.title: Garden is off for this repository
screens.description: skipped: a durable, reversible opt-out for this local clone.
screens.note: Enter starts setup again. Settings › Garden reflects the same state.
